exclusions.title: Financial Guarantee and Insolvency
exclusions.description: This Contract does not apply to financial guarantee and insolvency.

exclusions.title: Nuclear Risks
exclusions.description: Excludes nuclear risks as defined in the 'Nuclear Incident Exclusion Clause - Physical Damage - Reinsurance (U.S.A.)'.
cross_references: Nuclear Incident Exclusion Clause - Physical Damage - Reinsurance (U.S.A.)

exclusions.title: War and Hostilities
exclusions.description: Excludes loss or damage caused by war, invasion, hostilities, acts of foreign enemies, civil war, rebellion, insurrection, military or usurped power, or martial law.
exceptions: This exclusion shall not apply to loss or damage covered under a standard policy with a standard War Exclusion Clause.

exclusions.title: Pools, Associations and Syndicates
exclusions.description: Excludes loss or liability under the provisions of the 'Pools, Associations and Syndicates Exclusion Clause'.
cross_references: Pools, Associations and Syndicates Exclusion Clause

exclusions.title: Insolvency Fund Liability
exclusions.description: Excludes all liability arising from participation or membership in any insolvency fund.

exclusions.title: Third Party Liability
exclusions.description: Excludes all third-party liability, including Section II of Homeowners.

exclusions.title: Growing or Standing Crops
exclusions.description: Excludes loss or damage to growing or standing crops.

exclusions.title: Pollution and Seepage
exclusions.description: Excludes pollution and seepage coverages under the provisions of the 'Pollution and Seepage Exclusion Clause (BRMA 39A)'.

exclusions.title: Terrorism
exclusions.description: Excludes terrorism as described in the provisions of the 'Terrorism Exclusion (NMA 2930c)'.

exclusions.title: Flood and Earthquake
exclusions.description: Excludes flood and/or earthquake when written as such.

exclusions.title: Fungi
exclusions.description: Excludes loss, damage, cost or expense arising from fungi unless caused by a covered peril under the Company's original policy.

exclusions.title: Growing, Standing or Drying Crops or Timber
exclusions.description: Excludes growing, standing or drying crops or timber.

exclusions.title: Nuclear Incident Exclusion Clause - Physical Damage - Reinsurance (U.S.A.)
exclusions.description: This Reinsurance does not cover any loss or liability accruing to the Reassured from any Pool of Insurers or Reinsurers formed for covering Atomic or Nuclear Energy risks.
exceptions: Risks using radioactive isotopes where nuclear exposure is not considered primary hazard.

exclusions.title: Pools, Associations and Syndicates Exclusion Clause
exclusions.description: Excludes business derived from Pools, Associations, or Syndicates maintaining reinsurance facilities.
exceptions: Inland Marine risks under $250,000,000 Total Insured Value

exclusions.title: Pollution and Seepage Exclusion Clause
exclusions.description: Excludes loss or damage arising from seepage, pollution, or contamination, except smoke contamination.
exceptions: Cost of removing debris of property damaged by covered loss, subject to 25% limit.

exclusions.title: Terrorism Exclusion (Property Treaty Reinsurance)
exclusions.description: Excludes loss, damage, cost, or expense caused by acts of terrorism.
exceptions: Personal lines losses not involving biological, chemical, radioactive, or nuclear contamination.
